answerQuality.question: How do you configure an MSMP workflow for access requests?
answerQuality.headSnippet: RACFFOBJECT, and GRACFFLOG tables under change control and SoD owner sign-off. I always prove it with an ARA toxic-user simulation, an ARM Instance Status path check, and a GRACFFLOG review when elevated access was used.
answerQuality.curSnippet: by confirming path, stage, Approvers of Selected Path, and the audit log on a positive request, then a negative agent or mapping case; I open provisioning logs only after approval when the target assignment itself fails.
